findings.invariant: Maturity boundaries including missing and unsettled labels; focused regression quality
findings.reproducer: The fixture has training quote dates 2001-01-01 through 2001-01-25, labels one day later (latest 2001-01-26), and val_start 2001-02-01. Therefore it contains no training label settling on or after the validation boundary. Removing the new label_reaches mask would leave the asserted fixture fit rows unchanged.
findings.consequence: The named purge test does not protect its negative boundary case. A future mask regression could reject an otherwise valid panel containing both mature and unsettled labels without this test detecting it. Independent reviewer probes with settlement equal to and after val_start passed on the candidate; no current runtime maturity defect was found.
findings.disposition: Deferred Minor backlog. Preserve the active replay and immutable candidate; add a real equal-boundary/later-settlement row in a future test change.
